title: Netflix CEOs defend Warner Bros deal: What they say on Paramount bid, job loss fears, theatrical release and more
description: Netflix executives addressed concerns over their $82.7 billion acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery after a rival bid from Paramount.

title: CityMall’s small-basket gamble: Can no-frills ecommerce crack Bharat?
description: CityMall is taking on one of the toughest e-commerce challenges in India: winning small-town shoppers on wafer-thin margins. It has backers with deep pockets, a stripped-down supply chain and big ambitions. But it is yet to crack the market and build scale.

title: Madhusudan Kela urges focus on fundamentals as OFS dominates IPOs
description: Ace investor Madhusudan Kela emphasized that exits are not a concern if the company does not require fresh capital, and the public issue is attractively priced.

title: ArcelorMittal Nippon JV in India to expand nearly 3x by 2030 braving iron ore costs
description: Low steel prices and high iron ore costs have resulted in muted realizations for Indian steelmakers, with margin pressures limiting their ability to fund the aggressive capacity expansion, says AMNS India CEO Dilip Oommen.

title: upGrad begins IPO preparations for a $350–400 million 2027 listing
description: The Temasek-backed company is pursuing acquisitions, including parts of Byju’s and a possible Unacademy deal, as it resets its business ahead of a public listing.

title: Why older Indians are finding a second career as influencers
description: With retirement secured and pressure lower, professionals in their 40s, 50s and 60s are turning to content creation for income, fulfilment and freedom.

title: Delhi HC defers Apple challenge to CCI’s global turnover penalty rules to January
description: The court will hear Apple’s plea against India’s revised competition law in January 2026, a case that could shape how Big Tech is fined under the new CCI framework

title: Vedanta wins approval for demerger plan from Mumbai NCLT, overcomes petroleum ministry's objections
description: The petroleum ministry’s opposition has been the biggest hurdle in getting approval from the NCLT for Vedanta's restructuring plan.

title: ‘Didn’t buy Warner Bros to harm value’, says Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos, assures they ‘will continue theatre releases’
description: Netflix chief Ted Sarandos assured that the company will continue cinema releases for Warner Bros movies. Days prior, in a letter to staff, Sarandos and co-CEO Greg Peters affirmed they will continue theatrical releases for Warner Bros films.

title: Not Mark Zuckerberg, Tim Cook, Jensen Huang — This Indian-origin leader was the highest-paid tech CEO of 2025
description: The highest-paid tech CEO of fiscal 2025 was Satya Nadella, who took home a fat paycheck of $96.5 million. This was his highest compensation since he became CEO more than a decade ago.

description: Wingreens Farms has appointed JM Financial to raise up to  ₹200 crore as it sharpens unit economics, narrows losses and works towards a potential IPO over the next 2–3 years.

description: According to the reports, Amazon's investment in OpenAI could exceed around $10 billion along with an agreement to use its AI chips.

title: Bhavish Aggarwal net worth drops! How much money does Ola Electric CEO have after selling 2.62 crore shares?
description: Bhavish Aggarwal, the CEO of Ola Electric Mobility, owned 30.02% or more than 1,32,39,60,029 equity shares in the two-wheeler automaker as of September 2025, according to BSE data.

title: Warner Bros Discovery to reject Paramount's $108 billion bid? Netflix may emerge winner of mega deal — What we know
description: The Warner Bros. board, which deliberated on Paramount's bid, still holds the view that Netflix's offer is a better one, according to people who spoke to Bloomberg.

title: Elon Musk now richer than Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg and Jensen Huang combined — he still has $69 billion to spare
description: According to Forbes Real-Time Billionaires, Elon Musk's net worth has crossed $684 billion, making him the first person in the world to reach that milestone, following reports that his SpaceX venture may go public at a valuation of $800 billion.

title: Japan’s Mizuho enters Indian investment banking space with $523 million Avendus deal
description: Japan’s Mizuho Securities will acquire a majority stake in Indian investment bank Avendus from KKR for up to $523 million, expanding its footprint in India’s fast-growing financial market.

title: Former AMD Engineer may become a billionaire after Chinese chip IPO set to list at $5.9 billion
description: According to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, Chen holds 55 million shares in MetaX Integrated Circuits Shanghai Co., worth at least 5.8 billion yuan ($824 million) at the offer price.

title: Govt weighs  ₹5,000 crore capital infusion for three PSU insurers as losses return
description: After a brief profit uptick in FY25 failed to repair balance sheets, the Centre is revisiting a capital plan to shore up solvency and pave the way for consolidation or sale of state-owned general insurers.

title: $1 bn Telefónica UK win ends mega-deal dry spell for TCS but it's not out of the woods yet
description: TCS has won a $1 billion contract from Telefónica UK, ending a drought in large deals. The agreement for application and infrastructure services reflects a strategic shift towards long-term growth even if it impacts short-term margins. Read this exclusive story on the TCS mega deal.

title: RailTel plans to partner with Elon Musk's Starlink. Why it may be great for both
description: State-owned RailTel is exploring the use of Starlink’s satellite internet services as backhaul to provide broadband access in remote areas through RailWire.&nbsp;

title: Google brings Indic AI to agriculture and healthcare
description: Google’s latest effort has seen the company embed 29 Indic languages and dialects into Gemini, its foundational AI model, as it looks to scale AI adoption across India’s hinterlands, three years after it began work in the area.

title: Singapore Bank UOB Struggles With Hong Kong, China Property Loans as Prices Sink
description: A large wager on Hong Kong and China real estate is backfiring on one of Singapore’s top banks, which is facing up to mounting troubles in the region’s deteriorating property markets.

title: Trump Slams Paramount Over CBS Coverage as Warner Battle Looms
description: President Donald Trump expressed unhappiness with the owners of Paramount Skydance Corp. over CBS News coverage of his presidency, in the latest signal of how he may be leaning in the battle to purchase Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.

title: First Brands Founder James Says Lenders to Blame for Bankruptcy
description: First Brands founder Patrick James asked a judge to dismiss a lawsuit accusing him of misappropriating hundreds of millions of dollars, contending firms that provided his company with off balance-sheet financing engaged in “predatory” practices that helped tip the auto-parts supplier into bankruptcy.

title: Brazilian Carrier Azul Will Turn Profit in 2026 After Bankruptcy
description: Brazilian budget carrier Azul SA, now backed by United Airlines Holdings Inc. and American Airlines Group Inc., expects a bankruptcy-triggered reduction of debt and a slew of renegotiated aircraft leases to help it generate a profit the next two years.

title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images, its answer to Google's viral Nano Banana
description: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Images, a new feature for editing and generating visuals in its app, following Google's Nano Banana success. It promises improved efficiency in creative tasks, while raising concerns about copyright and user privacy in AI-generated content.

title: Bombay High Court allows Hiremath siblings to include Bharat Forge shares in intra-family inheritance suit
description: The ongoing inheritance suit filed by siblings Sameer Hiremath and Pallavi Swadi, children of Sugandha Hiremath, against the promoter family of the Kalyani Group took a significant turn when the court allowed the inclusion of promoter shares of Bharat Forge and Kalyani Steels into the dispute.&nbsp;

title: PayPal Bank on cards? Global payments giant seeks banking charter amid lending push in US — all you need to know
description: Payments giant PayPal has filed its banking charter application with US regulators to become a bank amid a broader push for fintech and crypto companies that are seeking a licence to expand their lending operations among customers and small businesses.&nbsp;

title: Tata and Infosys to bear brunt of Donald Trump’s $100,000 H-1B worker fee
description: President Donald Trump’s $100,000 price tag for new H-1B workers hired from outside the US will have punishing effects for the IT outsourcing and staffing industries that have long been a target of both parties.
